title: ForexFactory Economic Calendar Input
description: Pull the public ForexFactory economic calendar by date range. No login. Pay per event.

range.title: Date range
range.description: Preset date window. Choose 'custom' to use startDate and endDate.

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: First date to pull, inclusive. Required when range is 'custom'. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: Last date to pull, inclusive. Required when range is 'custom'. Max 30 days span. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

currencies.title: Currencies
currencies.description: ISO currency codes to include. Empty pulls every currency on the calendar.

impactLevels.title: Impact levels
impactLevels.description: Impact ratings to include. Default keeps high and medium only. Add 'low' or 'holiday' to widen.

includeDetail.title: Include event detail
includeDetail.description: Fetch each event's detail page for description, source agency, frequency, and revision history. Adds one extra request per event; detail is fetched for the first 50 matched events per run, the rest are returned without detail.

maxEvents.title: Max events
maxEvents.description: Stop after this many event rows. Default 1000 covers a full month of high+medium events.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of pages processed in parallel. Three is a safe default for ForexFactory.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential is required at any meaningful volume.
